basic_info.description: Welcome to 109 Lowell St, a rare opportunity in the heart of Crocker Amazon for those with a vision to craft their dream home. This property, offered at lot value, presents the ideal canvas for transformation, inviting you to reimagine and redesign from the ground up. Located near the bustling shops and eateries of Mission Street, as well as convenient public transportation, this property offers both location and potential.  With a flat backyard, there's ample space to create an ADU or a customized outdoor retreat, perfect for relaxation or entertainment. Whether you envision a modern sanctuary, a traditional family home, or something uniquely tailored, 109 Lowell St is your chance to bring that dream to life. Don't miss the opportunity to invest in a prime San Francisco neighborhood and make your mark on this fixer-upper gem.
